name: flame-switch
title: FlameSwitch
description: control: On/off switch with a live pilot flame on its knob (canvas 2D, server-safe switch, reduced motion -> switch only, touch -> same switch)

item.name: flame-switch
item.summary: control: On/off switch with a live pilot flame on its knob (canvas 2D, server-safe switch, reduced motion -> switch only, touch -> same switch)

useWhen: A setting that turns something on or off and deserves a moment of character (a feature flag, a 'live' mode, a heater, a stream)
Brand or product pages built around fire, heat or energy
A single prominent toggle in a hero, a settings card or a demo
avoidWhen: Long settings lists with many toggles in a row (use the host's plain switch)
Light pages where a dark switch body would look out of place

alternatives.name: eclipse-switch
alternatives.when: When the toggle switches between light and dark themes

tiers.0: The switch only (server render, reduced motion, Save-Data, no WebGL2): no canvas
tiers.2: Flame on a canvas at DPR ≤ 1.5 with half the flame particles
tiers.3: Flame on a canvas at DPR ≤ 2 with the full particle count

reducedMotion.description: The switch alone: no canvas, no flame, the knob moves without a transition. The state and the status text work as usual.

input.pointer: Click toggles; moving the pointer past a lit flame leans it like a breath
input.keyboard: A native button with role=switch: Space and Enter toggle, focus ring visible

a11y.notes: A native <button role="switch"> with aria-checked and the required `label` as its accessible name. The flame canvas is aria-hidden; the visible status text under the switch follows the state.

props.name: checked
props.effect: Controlled state. Leave undefined for an uncontrolled switch.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.effect: Called with the new state on every press.

props.name: statusText
props.effect: Visible status under the switch; null hides it.

props.name: palette
props.effect: Flame colours (DESIGN.md A8). custom reads --fb-heat-0..4 from the page.

props.name: paused
props.effect: Universal pause prop: the flame stops drawing; the switch still works.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on the capability tier (0 = switch only).

props.name: nonce
props.effect: CSP nonce for the component's <style> element.

props.name: className
props.effect: Extra classes on the root (fb-flame-switch is kept).

props.name: style
props.effect: Inline styles on the root, merged after the palette variables.

mistakes: label is required: it is the switch's only accessible name. Do not rely on nearby text.
The flame draws above the switch (about 140 px): leave room above it and do not clip the parent with overflow: hidden.
Use it for one or two important toggles, not for every row of a settings list.
verify: Server HTML has a <button role="switch"> with aria-checked and the label.
Space toggles the switch when it has focus and the status text follows.
With reduced motion there is no canvas and no frame runs; the switch still toggles.
